title: Localization of the normalized strict reindexing comparisons
statement: Let l be prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and g:X→Y a scheme isomorphism with l invertible in every residue field. Given strict reindexing comparisons with all coordinate, naturality, shift, and restricted-section laws; simultaneous quotient isomorphisms normalized on all tensor generators and commuting with quotient transitions; and comparisons from actual completion to the selected reduction/limit composites, there exist coherent derived reduction, limit, finite evaluation, finite restriction and finite extension comparisons, together with actual K-injective Roos models and a normalized pullback realization. They satisfy reduction/evaluation, limit/projection, whole-system unit, finite-representative, full Roos-limit, and prescribed pullback-normalization equations on all ambient derived objects. [def-pod-completion-reindex-models] [lem-pod-reindexing-strict-comparisons]

source.place: Steps 1 and 5; strict quotient and Roos comparison argument.

proof.text: Split the normalized package into its five core comparison laws and the pullback normalization. The core theorem supplies a derived-data witness R with the five laws. The pullback theorem supplies a normalized realization p of the completed pullback for the target Roos model of R. Replacing the pullback field of R by p keeps the five laws, which do not involve that field, and gives the sixth law. Assemble the conjunction.
